panel.label: PBR
panel.name: ss_pbr
panel.text: Control Physically Based Rendering (PBR) features and classic rendering fallbacks.

check_box.label: Enable PBR Rendering
check_box.name: ss_pbr_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Master switch for all Physically Based Rendering features. When unchecked, all PBR systems are disabled and the viewer operates in Classic ALM mode.

check_box.label: glTF PBR Materials
check_box.name: ss_pbr_materials
check_box.tool_tip: Renders modern glTF metallic/roughness materials on objects and avatars. When unchecked, objects render using lightweight Blinn-Phong textures, saving significant VRAM and network download bandwidth.

check_box.label: Smart Classic Fallback for Blank Textures
check_box.name: ss_pbr_smart_fallback
check_box.tool_tip: If a PBR object has no legacy texture (or was left as default plywood/blank white), automatically use its glTF base color and normal map in classic mode so it still looks textured without downloading full PBR ORM maps.

check_box.label: PBR Terrain
check_box.name: ss_pbr_terrain
check_box.tool_tip: Enables multi-plane PBR terrain textures. When unchecked, reverts to classic 4-layer terrain splatting to reduce GPU draw calls.

check_box.label: PBR Reflection Probes
check_box.name: ss_pbr_probes
check_box.tool_tip: Enables dynamic environmental reflection cubemaps. Unchecking this eliminates probe render passes—often the single largest source of framerate drops in PBR areas.

check_box.label: Classic Lighting Mode (Pre-PBR Tone Curve)
check_box.name: ss_pbr_classic_lighting
check_box.tool_tip: Forces classic pre-PBR lighting math and tone curve, boosting direct sunlight and preventing washed-out haziness on legacy content and avatars.
